metadata.description: Of the House of Ingwë, King of the Vanyar. Her exact parentage varies in Tolkien's writings: in some versions she is the sister of Ingwë, in others his niece (daughter of his sister), and in later writings possibly his daughter. Known as 'Indis the Fair' and 'the Beautiful' for her golden Vanyarin hair. She became the second wife of Finwë, King of the Noldor, after the death of his first wife Míriel. Mother of four children: Findis, Fingolfin (ancestor of the Kings of Gondolin), Lalwen, and Finarfin (ancestor of the Kings of Nargothrond and Galadriel of Lórien). Through her, the Vanyarin bloodline entered the Noldor, giving her descendants their characteristic golden hair.
